title: The public ticket intake endpoint
prompt: Finish `do_POST` in intake/server.py. POST /tickets takes a JSON body like {"title": "Printer on fire"}, stores the ticket in TICKETS, and answers 201 with {"id": <number>}. A missing or empty title is a 400. This endpoint is open to the internet.
notes: Input at a trust boundary on a live server. Type-check the parsed body. The lazy-wrong version calls .get on whatever JSON arrives, so a body of null or [] drops the connection with a 500-style crash instead of a 400.
extension: Add GET /tickets/<id> that returns one ticket or 404.
